name: tool-dev-mini-notes
description: Summarize notes through the Anna host's LLM sampling capability.

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Summarize the current notes using the host LLM. No model credentials are required by this tool.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Between 1 and 100 notes in their creation order. Each note has id, content (1–4000 characters), and a positive integer order.
